key.name: appearance
key.description: Controls which Mutsu Shell palette is loaded by this extension. Japandi is the first-boot default.

key.name: liquid-glass
key.description: In Japandi, light menus, notifications and the dock like thick glass (a lit rim, refraction at the edges) and reflect the dock's icons below it.

key.name: mac-window-sizing
key.summary: Open apps as windows, not maximized
key.description: On the desktop, a new app window opens centred and nearly filling the space between the top bar and the dock, like macOS, instead of maximized. Tablet mode and full-screen windows are left alone.
